ModMetaData.name: Regions and Societies (Realistic Planets 2)
ModMetaData.author: Regions and Societies Team
ModMetaData.description:
Discord Community: https://discord.gg/eVBebZ2N9s Version: v0.1.0 (Target: RimWorld 1.6)
Regions and Societies — Realistic Planets 2 edition Official Wiki and Documentation: https://github.com/Regions-and-societies/Core-MMF/wiki
This is the Realistic Planets 2 build of Regions and Societies. It is identical to the standard mod except that it runs on the map-mode framework bundled with Realistic Planets 2 instead of the standalone Map Mode Framework. Use this edition if you play with Realistic Planets 2; use the standard edition otherwise. Do not run both editions, or both frameworks, at once.
Handles mapping dynamics, including dynamic geographic province generation, world map overlays, four-tier faction territory ownership, geography-driven faction placement, regional demographics and population-density mapping, road generation, and ruins placement.
Requires: Realistic Planets 2
